english.title: Cause a child under 14 years of age to ride a horse on a road without wearing specified protective headgear

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Horses Protective Headgear for young riders Act 1990

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused a child under the age of 14 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), to ride a horse on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), when the child was not wearing protective headgear in accordance with the Horses (Protective Headgear for Young Riders) Regulations 1992
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1 of the Horses (Protective Headgear for Young Riders) Act 1990.
